---
name: Good first contribution
description: Propose a small, testable improvement using synthetic data
title: "[contribution] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## What would you like to improve?

One workflow friction, failure mode, test, accessibility issue or documentation gap is enough.

## Why does it matter?

How could this improve time returned to care, trust, interoperability, safety or contributor experience?

## Smallest useful version

What could be completed and reviewed without turning into a giant rewrite?

## Evidence

How would we know it worked?

- [ ] regression test
- [ ] synthetic fixture
- [ ] screenshot / interaction proof
- [ ] measurement
- [ ] documentation example

## Safety

- [ ] synthetic data only
- [ ] no credentials / PHI / private hospital material
- [ ] no change to patient scope, model authority or write permissions

If the last box is not true, explain the safety-sensitive part clearly.
